rendered:
version: conductor.config/2
daemon:
  store: sqlite:/var/lib/conductor/data/conductor.sqlite
  secrets:
    source: files
    dir: /run/secrets/conductor
  unattended: true
  operators: []
instances:
- name: alpha
  session_prefix: alpha
  placement: none
  gates_policy: null
  model_token: secret:alpha-model
  sources:
  - github: example-org
  checkouts:
    root: /var/lib/conductor/data/checkouts
    trees: /var/lib/conductor/data/trees
  records: /var/lib/conductor/data/records
  state: /var/lib/conductor/data/state
  cache: /var/lib/conductor/data/cache
  roles:
  - role: conductor
    kind: claude-code
    harness: claude
    model: opus
    agent: null
    settings: null
    profile: null
    session_name: alpha-conductor
    read_only_tools: []
    limits:
      memory_max: null
      cpu_weight: null
      tasks_max: null
    writable:
    - checkout
    - trees
    - build-cache
    - scratch
    - harness-state
    - records
    network: open
    forge_token_env: []
    grant:
      tools:
      - show
      - search
      - diff
      repositories: []
      paths: []
      max_output_bytes: 65536
      ttl: null
    token_owner: null
  - role: conductor-dev
    kind: claude-code
    harness: claude
    model: opus
    agent: null
    settings: null
    profile: null
    session_name: alpha-conductor-dev
    read_only_tools: []
    limits:
      memory_max: null
      cpu_weight: null
      tasks_max: null
    writable:
    - checkout
    - trees
    - build-cache
    - scratch
    - harness-state
    network: open
    forge_token_env: []
    grant:
      tools:
      - show
      - search
      - diff
      repositories: []
      paths: []
      max_output_bytes: 65536
      ttl: null
    token_owner: null
  - role: controller
    kind: claude-code
    harness: claude
    model: opus
    agent: null
    settings: null
    profile: null
    session_name: null
    read_only_tools: []
    limits:
      memory_max: null
      cpu_weight: null
      tasks_max: null
    writable:
    - checkout
    - trees
    - build-cache
    - scratch
    - harness-state
    network: open
    forge_token_env: []
    grant:
      tools:
      - show
      - search
      - diff
      repositories: []
      paths: []
      max_output_bytes: 65536
      ttl: null
    token_owner: null
  limits:
    memory_max: null
    cpu_weight: null
    tasks_max: null
  forge:
    route: gates
  controllers:
    max_working: 5
    max_subagents: 4
    max_open_reviews: 3
  repositories: []
  cadence:
    cycle: 2h
    daily: 08:07
    watch: 180s
    ci: 900s
  thresholds:
    context_handover: 300k
    disk_path: /
    disk_low: 100G
    disk_clear: 110G
    disk_admit: 20G
    build_slot: 60G
    build_size: 10G
    gate_stop: 15G
    gate_resume: 17G
    watchdog_every: 10s
    silent_session: 30m
    cpu_reserve: 2
    build_slots: 3
    repo_cache: on
    repo_cache_size: 2G
    lean_debuginfo: true
    short_lane_slots: 1
    short_lane_max: 3m
    stalled_session: 45m
    build_queued: 30m
    tree_stale: 48h
  retention:
    snapshots: 12
  reports: []
  authority:
    class_c: conductor
    class_o: operator
  usage:
    probe: null
    watcher: null
    rotate: null
  operator: null
  catalog: null
  secret_syncs: []
